items.title: 2.2.1 Variables, Data Types and I/O (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Yeh hissa variables, bunyadi data types aur input aur output batata hai: program data kaise rakhta hai, kis qism ka data rakh sakta hai, aur user se kaise baat karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke teen khayalat bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Variables (naam wali jagah), data types (int, float, str, bool) aur input/output (input() aur print()).

items: Variables data rakhte hain; data types batate hain kis qism ka; input() user se leta aur print() output dikhata hai.
